chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Break the heat of the fever with the violet (oil).'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended treatment for fever according to Imam Ali in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi*’s chapter on violet oil, this hadith links Imam Ali’s practical medical advice to the broader Shia tradition of integrating prophetic medicine (*al-Tibb al-Nabawi*) with empirical observation. It highlights the continuity of scientific inquiry within the Imams, where natural remedies like violet (*banafsaj*) were prescribed not merely as folk remedies but as part of a holistic understanding of humoral balance and divine creation.
